---
title: "SPD test"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(rcarbon)

dates <- read_excel("Demographic analysis sites.xlsx")

calDates <- calibrate(
  x = dates$C14Age,
  errors = dates$C14SD,
  calCurves = "intcal20"  
)

bins <- binPrep(
  sites = dates$Site,
  ages = dates$C14Age,
  h = 200
)

spd_res <- spd(
  calDates, 
  bins = bins,
  timeRange = c(25000, 5000))
plot(spd_res)

```
